subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91da09c7f507bbdb721a5c8512bd66cf8049a3713ea1f26d4e298f81af667f9e.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -2.

Let's check each option:

1. PS–WR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18381cd9a28e7b064adfec37202a3f60d68e8f6bbf5334cf2a4d10351304e2e9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +7, -2.
2. SV–ZT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc0efe615d534f9e4269833ffb5ccf31493c342cef0ef2b84342502cd4480a2d.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -2.
3. MP–TN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3254e812fe199f4b6462c8d5f82d7b82687fd9c739b3bd93b15427defedaaa4b.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -2.

4. JM–QK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3474f99f02035017e4dfbc30675ccf21f20e1240998ee640f7994cf106740c9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -2.

Thus, PS-WR is the odd one out.

 
Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**"
